steps.title: The sidebar opens the default Unread page with authoritative feedback
Unread, All and Archived each load their complete second server page
Distinct notification IDs preserve exact run, comment, body and issue targets
Same-issue Back/Forward restores distinct notification offsets without remounting the draft
Account Back/Forward and workspace scope resume restore selection and painted offsets
Compact detail keeps the hidden list mounted and returns through a real back link
Confirmed read and archive update membership and the badge without closing authorized detail
